_about: Example produce job for pipeline/produce.py. Copy it, point 'source' at a video file YOU own or have the rights to use, and list the moments the winner picker shipped (score is its /10). Paths resolve relative to this file. Run: python3 -m pipeline.produce shorts config/produce.example.json — or 'compilation' instead of 'shorts' to join the moments into one long video, best clip last.
